title: Product of a normal current with [[0,1]]: t-integral formula, support, mass and boundary formula (parent A2; Simon 6.2.17–2.22)
statement: Assume (VO) for all P, n, U, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0 (the frozen type of Submission.dtc_vanish_off_support) and (REP) for U open and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U there are a Borel measure μ (μ(ℝ^P ∖ U) = 0, finite on compact subsets of U) and ξ (μ-a.e. strongly measurable, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α) with M_W(T) = μ(W) for open W, T(ω) = ∫ ξ(ω) dμ, and, if also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U, μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0. Write ι(t, x) := (t, x_1, …, x_N) ∈ ℝ^{N+1} (Lean WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))), e₀ := (1, 0, …, 0) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) and Jv := ι(0, v), and call X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) = GeometricCurrentOn univ k NC when spt X is compact, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ (= M(∂X) < ∞ for k ≥ 1, automatic for k = 0). Then there is an operator cyl_{N,k} : 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) → 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) (all N, k) such that: (C1) for NC X, spt cyl(X) is compact, M(cyl X) ≤ M(X), M(∂cyl X) < ∞ and spt cyl(X) ⊆ {ι(t, x) : t ∈ [0,1], x ∈ spt X}; (C2) cyl(X − Y) = cyl(X) − cyl(Y) for NC X, Y; (C3) for NC X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) and every ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) there is a family η : ℝ → 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with η_t(x)(v_1, …, v_k) = ω(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_k) for all t, x, v, and cyl(X)(ω) = ∫_0^1 X(η_t) dt; (C4) for X ∈ 𝒟_0(ℝ^N) with compact support and M(X) < ∞ and ω ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^{N+1}) there are η₀, η₁ ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^N) with η_s(x) = ω(ι(s, x)) (s = 0, 1) and ∂cyl(X)(ω) = X(η₁) − X(η₀); (C5) for X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞, M(∂X) < ∞ and ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) there are η₀, η₁ ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^N) with η_s(x)(v) = ω(ι(s, x))(Jv_1, …, Jv_{k+1}) (s = 0, 1) and ∂cyl(X)(ω) = X(η₁) − X(η₀) − cyl(∂X)(ω).
